market_question: Will Marco Rubio win the 2028 US Presidential Election?
reasoning: Given the 2028 election is nearly 4 years away and no clear frontrunner exists, the probability any single candidate wins is very low. Historical betting data show that even leading politicians rarely hold >10% probability this far out. A more realistic estimate for Rubio is 2-3%, making the market's 13.8% overpriced, so I recommend betting No.
evidence_points: No declared 2028 candidates; field is wide open with many potential strong contenders from both parties.
In early-cycle prediction markets for presidential elections, individual probabilities seldom exceed single digits.
Rubio's previous presidential bid (2016) and current Senatorial role do not make him a prohibitive favorite.
sources_consulted: General knowledge of election prediction markets (e.g., Polymarket historical data)
